company.name: Brain Corp
company.shortDescription: Brain Corp develops core technology for the robotics industry.
company.description:
Brain Corp is a San Diego-based AI company creating transformative core technology for the robotics industry. Brain Corp’s comprehensive solutions support the builders of today’s autonomous machines in successfully producing, deploying, and supporting robots across commercial industries and applications. It was named the world’s top autonomy solution provider by ABI Research.

Brain Corp was founded in 2009 and is based in San Diego, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: Brain Corp is researching systems and methods for optimizing robotic route planning, automatic route generation, and detection of features within data collected by robots. Their work includes enhancing task performance and mapping using modular sensors, robotic control with LiDAR-assisted dead reckoning, and constructing high-resolution panoramic imagery. Additional focus areas are detection and correction of diverged maps, feature detection de-duplication, and robotic detection of escalators and glass surfaces.
